# UI_COMPLETION_REVIEW

### 1. Evidence Gates vs. UI Workflow Gaps
* **Preserved Evidence Gating (Correct Behavior):** In [products.py](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/ba604d1c1cf3/workspace/src/seed_search/catalog/products.py#L59-L82), all 16 presets and 22 records explicitly declare `availability_status='gated'` with missing dependencies (`exact_preset_evaluator`, `estimated_spawn_layout`, etc.). As required by [EXPANDED_PLAN.md](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/ba604d1c1cf3/workspace/reviews/correction-plan-2026-10-21/EXPANDED_PLAN.md#L28-L41), these gates must **not** be removed or relaxed. Displaying "Evidence pending" with missing dependencies is correct and must be preserved.
* **Personalized Pillar Ghost State (UI Workflow Gap):** [products.py](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/ba604d1c1cf3/workspace/src/seed_search/catalog/products.py#L59-L91) defines no products for `personalized`. In [index.tsx](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/ba604d1c1cf3/workspace/web-ui/src/catalog/pillars/index.tsx#L105-L107), introductory copy is provided for `realm`, `presets`, and `rare`, but `personalized` is omitted entirely. Switching to "Personalized Selection" renders a completely blank main view with zero controls for anchor modes (Origin vs. Recommended/Spawn), Required/Preferred semantics, or border bounds (2048, 4096, 8192).
* **Missing Snapshot Controller (UI Workflow Gap):** [`ResearchList`](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/ba604d1c1cf3/workspace/web-ui/src/catalog/pillars/index.tsx#L46) immediately halts with `"Select an available catalog snapshot..."` if `snapshotId` is blank. However, [`ProductPillar`](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/ba604d1c1cf3/workspace/web-ui/src/catalog/pillars/index.tsx#L102-L131) lacks any snapshot selector UI or fallback prompt.

### 2. Usability, Accessibility & Correctness Bugs
* **Focus Loss on Criteria Dismissal ([index.tsx](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/ba604d1c1cf3/workspace/web-ui/src/catalog/pillars/index.tsx#L103-L121)):** Line 103 focuses `inspector.current` on open. When closing via `Escape` (L120) or "Close criteria" (L121), the inspector unmounts without returning focus to the invoking card trigger button, leaving browser focus stranded at `document.body`.
* **Detached Clipboard Error Notice ([index.tsx](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/ba604d1c1cf3/workspace/web-ui/src/catalog/pillars/index.tsx#L83-L101)):** On clipboard write failure, `setCopied('failed')` renders an alert at line 101 at the bottom of the entire research list, disassociated from the individual row being copied.
* **Inaccessible SVG Witness Coordinates ([index.tsx](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/ba604d1c1cf3/workspace/web-ui/src/catalog/pillars/index.tsx#L92-L98)):** Predicted coordinates rely exclusively on SVG `<circle><title>` elements (L96). These are inaccessible to keyboard and non-pointer users. Coordinates must be provided in an accessible text/table summary.
* **Navigation Semantics ([index.tsx](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/ba604d1c1cf3/workspace/web-ui/src/catalog/pillars/index.tsx#L29-L33)):** [`PillarNavigation`](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/ba604d1c1cf3/workspace/web-ui/src/catalog/pillars/index.tsx#L28-L34) uses `aria-current="page"` for in-page view switching instead of standard tablist/tab semantics (`role="tablist"`, `role="tab"`, `aria-selected`).

### 3. Bounded Browser Acceptance Cases (Port 3001/5173)
* **TC-UI-01 (Personalized Interaction State):**
  1. Click `Personalized Selection`.
  2. Verify an informative view renders explaining anchor constraints (Origin vs. Recommended), Required/Preferred rules, and border options, preventing an empty screen.
* **TC-UI-02 (Keyboard Focus Trapping & Restoration):**
  1. Tab to Preset card `The Six-Pack` and press `Enter`.
  2. Verify focus shifts immediately to the criteria inspector container.
  3. Press `Escape`. Verify criteria closes and focus restores to `The Six-Pack` button.
* **TC-UI-03 (Snapshot Selector & Research Guard):**
  1. Mount component with empty `snapshotId`.
  2. Navigate to `Rare Seeds` -> open `Village density preview`.
  3. Verify a clear selection UI prompt appears rather than an uncaught terminal error.
* **TC-UI-04 (Gated Criteria Integrity):**
  1. Open Preset `Nether Duo`.
  2. Verify criteria lists `nether_observations` and `starter_portal_reference` under missing dependencies.
  3. Verify no fabricated seeds or mock results are displayed.
* **TC-UI-05 (Witness Inspection & Copy Verification):**
  1. In `trial_chamber` research preview, toggle "View circle map".
  2. Verify SVG exposes `role="img"` with count description and that witness coordinates $(X, Z)$ are exposed accessibly.
  3. Click "Copy seed" and verify inline row state transitions to "Copied".
